scope: All saved SWAgent-online C2 initial-FAIL/final-PASS transitions; no score-based selection within this transition set
checks: Exact semantic user-content match to actual API payload user message containing nonempty HTTP(S) source body windows; matching received response ID and response text equals saved semantic raw; parsed response equals UPDATE proposal in trace. Accepted nonempty patch is reported separately.
boundaries: Mechanical provenance only; does not establish relevance, correctness, authority or temporal applicability of source content
Source-containing request precedes the recorded corresponding UPDATE, but this does not isolate retrieval as the causal reason for the final model
Initial request without body sources is not necessarily before internet use: PLAN may already include search snippets
A saved request without a received matching response and consumed trace proposal is insufficient
